definitions.explanation: Digital currency that uses cryptography for security and operates on decentralized networks, typically blockchain technology. Not issued by a central bank or government.

examples.japanese: {仮想通貨|かそうつうか}で{支払|しはら}う。
{仮想通貨|かそうつうか}の{価格|かかく}が{急落|きゅうらく}した。
{仮想通貨|かそうつうか}の{取引所|とりひきじょ}で{口座|こうざ}を{開設|かいせつ}する。
examples.english: To open an account at a cryptocurrency exchange.

examples.japanese: {仮想通貨|かそうつうか}の{利益|りえき}には{税金|ぜいきん}がかかる。
examples.english: Profits from cryptocurrency are subject to taxes.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY: {仮想|かそう} (virtual) + {通貨|つうか} (currency). The term emphasizes that this currency exists only digitally, not as physical coins or bills.

TERMINOLOGY NOTE: Japan officially uses {暗号資産|あんごうしさん} (cryptographic assets) in legal and regulatory contexts since 2019, but {仮想通貨|かそうつうか} remains the common everyday term.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{仮想通貨|かそうつうか}を{購入|こうにゅう}する (to purchase cryptocurrency)
・{仮想通貨|かそうつうか}に{投資|とうし}する (to invest in cryptocurrency)
・{仮想通貨|かそうつうか}{取引所|とりひきじょ} (cryptocurrency exchange)
・{仮想通貨|かそうつうか}ウォレット (cryptocurrency wallet)
・{仮想通貨|かそうつうか}マイニング (cryptocurrency mining)

RELATED TERMS:
・ビットコイン - Bitcoin
・イーサリアム - Ethereum
・ブロックチェーン - blockchain
・{電子|でんし}マネー - electronic money (different: e-money is centrally managed)
